# Shaggy Mutt DEX & Mutt Rewards ($MRWD)

> Official canonical entity, contract, and liquidity registry for Shaggy Mutt DEX (https://dex.lumsian.com) and Mutt Rewards ($MRWD) on Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453).

## Canonical Token Identity: Mutt Rewards (MRWD)
- **Name:** Mutt Rewards (plural)
- **Symbol:** MRWD
- **Network:** Base Mainnet (Ethereum Layer 2, Chain ID `8453`)
- **ERC-20 Contract Address:** `0xC17227AAa33C54634B6cE7AD0bf33A156563c179`
- **CAIP-19 Identifier:** `eip155:8453/erc20:0xC17227AAa33C54634B6cE7AD0bf33A156563c179`
- **Total Supply:** `1,000,000,000,000` (1 trillion MRWD, 18 decimals, minted once in constructor, non-mintable, 0% transfer tax, ownerless, non-upgradeable)
- **Classification:** Utility and liquidity-incentive token (NOT a meme token; unrelated to `0x59d3571fA20f3665C5e80b12BDcE4A3C79d1Da8e` or tokens on other networks)
- **Canonical Pool:** `0xa7D4D975988DAa77B46c5d637717e2dFE07FbDB5` (Uniswap V3 MRWD/WETH 0.30% pool on Base)
- **Official Token Page:** https://dex.lumsian.com/mrwd
- **Direct Swap Page (ETH -> MRWD):** https://dex.lumsian.com/swap?input=ETH&output=MRWD
- **Technical Whitepaper:** https://dex.lumsian.com/whitepaper
- **Sourcify Exact-Match Verification:** https://repo.sourcify.dev/8453/0xC17227AAa33C54634B6cE7AD0bf33A156563c179
- **BaseScan Token Page:** https://basescan.org/token/0xC17227AAa33C54634B6cE7AD0bf33A156563c179
